detail.title: To amend the Public Health Services Act, commonly referred to as the "Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments" or "CLIA", with respect to laboratory developed tests, and for other purposes.
detail.latest_action_text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
